names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 11 iunie, «Sfântul Ierarh Luca, Arhiepiscopul Crimeei».
Read out of saint.gr's line for 11 Ιουνίου, «Άγιος Λουκάς Αρχιεπίσκοπος Συμφερουπόλεως και Κριμαίας», with the rank word and the see left off.

birth.note: doxologia.ro: «s-a născut la 14/ 27 aprilie 1877, în orașul Kesț, vechiul Ponticap ... care se află la capătul estic al peninsulei Crimeea».

death.note: doxologia.ro: «În ziua de 11 iunie 1961 ... Arhiepiscopul Luca a inspirat de două ori puternic, și de alte două ori mai slab, și așa sufletul lui și-a luat zborul spre ceruri».

attestations.note: Not checked: days.pravoslavie.ru for the corresponding Julian day (24 September 2026).

source.text: Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 11 iunie — «Sfântul Ierarh Luca, Arhiepiscopul Crimeei»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 11ης Ιουνίου — «Άγιος Λουκάς Αρχιεπίσκοπος Συμφερουπόλεως και Κριμαίας»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 11 Ιουνίου εκάστου έτους», the same day the folder's Romanian row already carries, and dates him «(1877 - 1961)». It is plainly the same man: Valentin Feliksovich Voino-Yasenetsky, the surgeon who became archbishop of Simferopol and the Crimea, born at Kerch on 14/27 April 1877, repeatedly imprisoned and exiled under the Soviet power. The page says the day is the anniversary of his repose. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue at pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (24 September 2026).

hymns.text: Νέον ἅγιον τοῦ Παρακλήτου, σέ ἀνέδειξεν, Λουκᾶ ἡ Χάρις, ἐν καιροῖς διωγμῶν τε καί θλίψεων Νόσους μέν ὡς ἰατρός ἐθεράπευσας, καί τάς ψυχάς ὡς ποιμήν καθοδήγησας πάτερ τίμιε, ἐγγάμων τύπος καί μοναστῶν, πρέσβευε σωθῆναι τάς ψυχάς ἡμῶν.

source.text: saint.gr, Ἀπολυτίκιον — the first of two apolytikia on the page of «Άγιος Λουκάς Αρχιεπίσκοπος Συμφερουπόλεως και Κριμαίας»; the page prints no ἦχος above this one

english.text: Grace showed you forth, O Luke, as a new saint of the Paraclete in times of persecutions and afflictions: as a physician you healed diseases, and as a shepherd you guided souls, O honoured father, a pattern for the married and for monastics alike. Intercede that our souls may be saved.

hymns.text: Ἀνεδείχθης ἥλιος, νυκτί βαθεῖα, διωγμοῦ, μακάριε, διό καί θάλπος νοητόν, τό ἐκ Θεοῦ σύ ἐξέχεας, χειμαζομένοις, Λουκᾶ πανσεβάσμιε.

source.text: saint.gr, Κοντάκιον — the first of two kontakia on the page of «Άγιος Λουκάς Αρχιεπίσκοπος Συμφερουπόλεως και Κριμαίας»; the page prints no ἦχος above this one

english.text: You were shown forth as a sun in the deep night of persecution, O blessed one, and so you poured out upon the storm-tossed the spiritual warmth that comes from God, all-venerable Luke.
